NVS Class 11 Admissions Online Form 2027 - Complete Details

Short Information : Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), has invited online applications for the Navodaya Vidyalaya JNV Selection Test for Class XI (2027- 28) on the official website of the NVS recently.
